description: This file defines the VariantVal class, representing a semi-structured data type used within Apache Spark. It includes methods for reading binary data from unsafe memory, converting to JSON, and comparing instances.

classes.name: VariantVal
classes.description: A class representing a semi-structured variant value with binary content and metadata, supporting serialization, JSON conversion, and unsafe memory reading.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the binary value part of the variant.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the variant.

methods.name: readFromUnsafeRow
methods.description: Reads a VariantVal instance from unsafe memory given an offset, base object, and base offset.

methods.name: debugString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string representation of the VariantVal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the VariantVal to a JSON string using a specified ZoneId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representation of the VariantVal in UTC.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another VariantVal based on binary content.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the binary value and metadata.
